module: Quarter-mile dragster race against an AI ("drag_opponent") on the dragstrips of the gridmap_v2 and west_coast_usa levels. Handles the starting tree (pre-stage, stage, amber, green, red lights), setting up the AI opponent (positions, pre-stage/stage/start, nitro/JATO), aligning the player on the line, false start detection, timing up to the finish trigger, the 7-segment displays (time and speed) and the UI results screen. Relies on named scene objects (Prestagelight_l, Amberlight1_R, display_time_1_l, dragTrigger, startTrigger_L...) and on the level's BeamNGTriggers. Global: freeroam_dragRace.
usage:
-- from a dragstrip trigger, the UI calls:
freeroam_dragRace.selectOpponent(freeroam_dragRace.selectRandomOpponent(true))
freeroam_dragRace.enableProTree(true) -- "pro" tree (immediate start on the 3 ambers)
notes: BUG: `M.onUpdate = onUpdate` and `M.startRace = startRace` export variables that are never defined in this file: M.onUpdate and M.startRace are therefore nil. Likewise setupStage tests `if startRace` (nil global variable).

BUG: in setupPrestage, the line `opponentVehicle:queLuaComuemand(...)` is a typo for queueLuaCommand: calling a nonexistent method raises a runtime error at the end of the pre-stage setup (the "AI_prestage" event is never sent to modded controllers and the rest of the function — be:enterVehicle, message — is not executed).
The angle conversions use 3.1459 as the value of pi (typo for 3.14159) in setupVehicle and selectOpponent (slight orientation error).

The current level (`level`) is a local variable set to 'gridmap_v2' by default; setLevel(lvl) changes it and reloads. The opponent/player reset positions are hardcoded per level. On gridmap_v2 the cinematic camera is disabled (cinematicCam=false in selectOpponent).
Times and speed are in seconds and mph (speedUnit factor = 2.2369362920544 applied to m/s). The displays have 5 digits per side; time < 10 adds an "empty" digit.

A false start (player crossing the line by more than 0.25 m during the countdown) disqualifies: red/amber lights on the player's side, the AI is stopped. Driving in the opponent's lane (laneTrigger_L) during the race also disqualifies.
In onBeamNGTrigger, `table.getn(vehicles)` and modifying `vehicles` during the traversal (table.remove inside pairs) can skip elements.

The module uses commands sent to the AI's VM: controller.setFreeze, ai.setSpeed/setAggression/setAvoidCars/setSpeedMode, electrics.values.jatoInput, controller nitrousOxideInjection, and the event controller.onGameplayEvent('freeroam_dragRace', 'AI_prestage'|'AI_stage'|'AI_setupStart'|'AI_start'|'AI_stop') for modded controllers.

accept.desc: Called by the "Accept/Configure" button of the dragstrip dialog: opens the overview screen (displayOverview(true, false)) which puts the simulation in slow motion (1/100) and navigates to menu.dragRaceOverview.

exit.desc: Quits the race: hides the menu, closes the dialog and the overview, deletes the drag_opponent scene object, forgets the opponent and reinitializes the module (onExtensionLoaded).

selectOpponent.desc: Chooses and spawns the opponent (core_vehicles.spawnNewVehicle with vehicleName 'drag_opponent', plate '2slow'), resets the race and the displays, and puts the player back on the starting line if needed.

selection.desc: {model, config, color} (e.g. an element of selectRandomOpponent).

selectRandomOpponent.desc: Randomly picks a car or truck config; with sameClass=true, restricts to configs whose 0-100 km/h is within ±1 s of the player vehicle's. Adds the model's Brand and Country for the UI.

sameClass.desc: true for a similar performance class.

returns.desc: Vehicle config entry (model_key, key, Brand, Country...).

setupPrestage.desc: Turns on the AI's pre-stage and makes the opponent advance or hold depending on whether the player is ready; see the bug (queLuaComuemand) in the notes.

setupStage.desc: Turns on the AI's stage light and makes it approach the line (speed 5, aggression 0).

startRace.desc: Exported but nil: no implementation in this file (see notes).

resetLights.desc: Hides all the light objects of the starting tree.

restartRace.desc: Restarts: resets the opponent and the player, returns to the menu, simulation at normal speed, orbit camera.

enableCinematicCam.desc: Reads or sets the use of the cinematic (external) camera during the race.

value.desc: New value; nil to only read.

enableProTree.desc: Reads or sets the "pro" tree (2 s countdown then the 3 ambers at 0.4 s then green) instead of the classic tree (successive ambers at 1.0/1.5/2.0 s, green at 2.5 s).

val.desc: New value; nil to only read.

closeOverview.desc: Closes the overview: puts the simulation back to 1x, the FOV to 65 and restores the previous camera.

setLevel.desc: Chooses the level for which the positions and cameras are hardcoded (gridmap_v2 or west_coast_usa) and reinitializes the module.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: finds the scene's lights, displays (display_time_i_l/r, display_speed_i_l/r, i = 1..5) and triggers, hides the displays and sets the reset positions according to the level.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: hides the menu, closes dialog and overview, deletes drag_opponent.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-level hook: empties the references to lights, displays, vehicles, triggers and results.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook, heart of the race: advances the countdown (starttimer in simulated time), the timer, the player alignment messages (distance to the line in m), the false start and the AI's pre-stage/stage/start phases.

dtSim.desc: Simulated duration (s), used for the timers.

onUpdate.desc: Exported but nil (no local onUpdate function defined).

onBeamNGTrigger.desc: Level trigger hook: entry/exit dialog (dragTrigger), finish (endTrigger: update of the displays and results, AI stop), opponent's lane (laneTrigger_L), vehicle registration (startTrigger_R/L) and preparation (dragTrigger_L).

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Spawn hook: if it is the opponent, hides the menu and places it (setupVehicle); also finds the player vehicle named "thePlayer".

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Vehicle deletion hook: forgets the player or the opponent and hides the lights.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Vehicle reset hook: closes the dialog if it is the player in the trigger; repositions the opponent (setupVehicle) if it is drag_opponent.
